'''RX-23''' was an [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-series pilot droid]] utilized during the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] at [[Spaceport THX1138]].<ref name="ST2 Tokyo" />

==Behind the scenes==
'''RX-23''' was a droid that could be found at the entrance queue in the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of the ride ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''. Its name was identified via a cargo box in the area.<ref name="ST2 Tokyo" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' {{C|Tokyo only}}
